title: Reading Drill — A Museum in One Room
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: A Museum in One Room
passages.body:
**A** A village museum wanted to show more objects without enlarging its single gallery. Its volunteers tried rotating displays, so a small number of items could be shown at a time and replaced during quiet weeks.

**B** Many visitors were happy to see different objects, but regular groups asked which items would be on view next month. Volunteers published a schedule to make group visits easier to plan.

**C** A separate handling box was left on the lower shelf for visitors who wanted to touch a copy of an original. It was designed so the activity could continue even when there was no guide in the room.
